instruction: Redis PUBSUB CHANNELS to list active channels
Redis PUBSUB NUMSUB to get subscriber count
Redis MEMORY USAGE of a key
Redis MEMORY STATS for memory statistics
Redis MEMORY PURGE to reclaim memory
Redis CLIENT KILL to disconnect a client
Redis CLIENT SETNAME to name a connection
Redis CLIENT GETNAME to get connection name
Redis CLIENT PAUSE to pause all clients
Redis CLIENT UNPAUSE to resume all clients
Redis CONFIG REWRITE to persist config changes
Redis CONFIG RESETSTAT to reset statistics
Redis ROLE to check instance role
Redis REPLICAOF to set replication
Redis REPLICAOF NO ONE to break replication
Redis WAIT to wait for replication
Redis OBJECT ENCODING to inspect internal encoding
Redis OBJECT IDLETIME to get idle time of key
Redis OBJECT REFCOUNT to get reference count
Redis DBSIZE to get number of keys
Redis FLUSHDB to clear current database
Redis SWAPDB to swap databases atomically
Redis RANDOMKEY to get a random key
Redis SORT to sort list, set, or sorted set
